duration.text: The Foreign Languages and Literature at Shenzhen University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate and diploma of bachelor's degree. Recent graduates shall provide pre-graduation certificate which shows your expected graduation time and present the original certification, diploma, transcripts, and translations when you register.2.The transcripts of all courses during bachelor period.3. Two Letters of Recommendation (Signed by professors or associate professors in Chinese or English with the name of the referral and contact information)4. One piece of Self-statement (around 800 words, and written in English or Chinese, and should include: personal experience of study, study plan etc.)5. Photo Copy of Passport Info Page6.Passport Photo7. Language Proficiency Certificate（1）Programs taught in Chinese：①A minimum score of 180 in HSK4 certification for Science and Engineering②A minimum score of 180 in HSK5 certification for Liberal Arts, Medicine, Arts（2）Programs taught in English：For applicant whose native tongue is not English requires credential of English proficiencyNative speakers of Chinese or English can be exempted from the corresponding language proficiency certificate after being recognized by our university.8.Foreigner Physical Examination Form9.Resume (from primary school to now)10.Applicants for Guangdong Government Outstanding International Student Scholarship, please download the form, fill it out and upload it.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be citizens with a valid foreign passport (whose nationalities are not People’s Republic of China). He / She should be in good health conditions and of good conduct. He / She should also abide by the Chinese laws, regulations and the rules of the university.2. Applicants should hold bachelor’s degree or above，and should be under the age of 35. Applicants who are still in the final year of undergraduate study can provide expected graduation certificate for submitting application while the official diploma must be provided before enrollment.3. Applicants should meet the corresponding language level requirements (The language proficiency certificate must be within the validity period).（1）Programs taught in Chinese：①A minimum score of 180 in HSK4 for Science and Engineering②A minimum score of 180 in HSK5 for Liberal Arts, Medicine, Arts（2）Programs taught in English：For applicant whose native tongue is not English requires credential of English proficiency.Native speakers of Chinese or English can be exempted from the corresponding language proficiency certificate after being recognized by our university.
